findings.question: q-physics-waves-and-sound-0022
findings.quote: This has the correct reason but the wrong result. Canceling needs a half wavelength. Check which path differences give canceling.
findings.problem: The note makes one half wavelength necessary for canceling. Odd multiples also give destructive interference: for example, a path difference of 3λ/2 makes waves from the stated in-phase speakers arrive in opposite phases. This repeats the false restriction corrected in question 0034.
findings.fix: Say that canceling needs an odd multiple of half a wavelength.
